name: Dot Com Mystery
source:
The school newspaper is running dry. No big stories, no scandals—just another ordinary semester. That is, until a mysterious forum called Mokshawelco starts predicting real-life deaths.

When an anonymous user posts cryptic clues about future tragedies, a group of young journalists sees an opportunity to uncover the truth—and make headlines. But as they dig deeper, they find themselves entangled in a dangerous web of secrets, deceit, and murder.

Will you expose the mastermind behind the forum, or become their next target?
